title: OTHRYS OS operating modes enforced by Trust Canal
goal: Make OBSERVE, PLAN, SUPERVISED_EXECUTE and AUTONOMOUS_EXECUTE first-class OS policy that constrains intent ingress and Trust Canal admission without granting authority.

work.problem: OTHRYS OS declares operating modes but they are not yet enforceable system law.
out_of_scope: No change to Talos evidence law
risks: A mode becomes a hidden authority grant
Ingress policy differs from Trust Canal admission policy
Autonomous mode silently becomes the default

laws: Operating mode only constrains actions; it never grants authority.
Trust Canal remains the enforcement boundary.
SUPERVISED_EXECUTE is the default to preserve the proven operator-gated chain.
AUTONOMOUS_EXECUTE still requires existing Trust Canal and Talos evidence contracts.

tasks.title: Define four operating modes and action classes
Prove mode decisions never grant authority
Verify invalid or weakened policies fail closed
Enforce mode again at Trust Canal admission
Prove direct inbox intent cannot bypass mode policy
